_comment: Hearthbound: BOTH Luki's Grand Capitals and Dungeons and Taverns override vanilla data/minecraft/worldgen/structure/village_taiga.json, so without this file whichever datapack loads last silently wins. This is LGC's version verbatim (the user installed LGC for its rebuilt villages, so LGC wins deliberately), shipped from the balance datapack which loads after mod jars. D&T's contribution is NOT discarded: it widened WHERE taiga villages spawn, and that is preserved via the has_structure/village_taiga tag alongside this file. Re-derive from the LGC jar if it updates.
